scope: Internal research ledger and candidates for HV-K14 Checkpoint 3 batches 1-2; not production rules, profile evidence, scores or personalized readings.
rightsBoundary: PO authorized internal reading and analysis of the local PDFs. The artifact stores short independent paraphrases and locators, not source passages or converted book text.

statusDefinitions.COMPLETED: The range was substantively read and its page-level QA is complete.
statusDefinitions.PENDING: The range is mapped but has not been substantively read.
statusDefinitions.REVIEW: The range was read, but source claims, sensitive language, ontology gaps or classification tables require further domain review.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: The range cannot currently be read reliably.
statusDefinitions.EXCLUDED: The range is navigation, provenance-only or outside the admitted knowledge scope.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.34-38, 3.2-3.14
conditions: The state labels are read as this book's branch-specific descriptions for the named major stars.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source supplies branch-based miếu, vượng, đắc and hãm descriptions for thirteen major stars in the completed continuation of its major-star catalog.
limitations: The Tử Vi subsection begins on pilot page 33 and is not re-extracted here.
No state lookup is activated and no favorable/adverse polarity is generalized across stars.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Adds Vietnamese-book provenance and explicit branch variants to existing star/state entities; merge rather than duplicate the catalog.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.36, 3.7 Thiên Phủ
conditions: Thiên Phủ is considered with one or more of Kình, Đà, Hỏa and Linh.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source describes Thiên Phủ as moderating individual adverse stars but explicitly limits that mitigation when all four named stars are present.
limitations: No magnitude, precedence or outcome is assigned.
The complete four-star condition must not be reduced to separate pairwise rules.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New explicit exception structure relative to K12/K13.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.35-36, 3.5 Thái Dương and 3.8 Thái Âm
conditions: The source combines positional state with day/night birth context, lunar phase for Thái Âm, and named companion or obstruction stars.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source treats Thái Dương and Thái Âm meanings as conditional on state, birth-time context and named co-occurring or obstructing factors.
limitations: Lunar-phase, Tuần/Triệt and companion-star dependencies are not fully represented in the current catalog.
Historical kinship and personal-outcome claims are excluded.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Extends K13's state context but requires missing dependencies before normalization.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.39, 3.19 Tả Phụ - Hữu Bật
conditions: Tả Phụ or Hữu Bật is interpreted with an existing surrounding set of favorable or adverse stars.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source treats the assistant pair as contextual amplifiers rather than as independently favorable in every configuration.
limitations: The source gives no geometry, threshold or weight.
No polarity is assigned without the surrounding configuration.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Semantically overlaps K13 assistant-conditioned star statements; merge the provenance and amplifier limitation.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.40-41, 3.23-3.26
conditions: A named Hóa star is read together with a named co-located or joined star set.
candidates.neutralStatement: The four Hóa descriptions include both reinforcement and limiting variants, so their source meanings are not presented as context-free fixed polarity.
candidates.evidenceType: source catalog with named conditional variants
limitations: Can-to-Hóa mapping is not included.
Medical, legal and event outcomes are excluded; only the contextual dependency is retained.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Broadens K13 Tứ Hóa context without duplicating a specific existing statement.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.42-43, 3.30 Thiên Mã
conditions: Thiên Mã appears with one of several explicitly named co-location or aspect combinations.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source organizes Thiên Mã interpretation into named combination variants whose meanings change with companion stars and relation type.
limitations: Several companion entities and relation terms are not cataloged.
Occupational, injury, death and status predictions are not admitted.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New family-level observation; blocked from normalized rules by missing entities and sensitive claims.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.49-51, 3.74-3.85
conditions: The twelve named stages are used as a sequence in this source's auxiliary-star vocabulary.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source presents a twelve-stage sequence from Tràng Sinh through Dưỡng and attaches contextual descriptions to individual stages.
limitations: The current foundation catalog has no stable entities for the twelve stages.
No placement algorithm or personal effect is admitted from these pages.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Potential catalog gap rather than a rule; requires ontology review before merge.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.41-51, selected auxiliary-star descriptions
conditions: The local descriptions directly assert medical, legal, reproductive, violent or event outcomes.
candidates.neutralStatement: The reviewed auxiliary-star section contains numerous direct historical outcome claims.
candidates.evidenceType: source claims rejected from reusable knowledge
limitations: The claims lack a safe modern interpretation boundary and adequate exception structure.
They are retained only as a rejection record, not as meanings or rules.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Rejected; no Knowledge Base statement is created.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.62-64, A and B.1
conditions: A palace is being interpreted within a complete chart.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source rejects isolated-palace reading and requires the focal palace to be reviewed within the twelve-palace and aspect context.
limitations: The text's philosophical explanation is not treated as calculation evidence.
No profile geometry is activated.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Merges with pilot and K13 non-isolation methodology while adding the full chapter context.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.64, B.1 Hệ thống phối chiếu
conditions: The source's own palace-review method is being described.
candidates.neutralStatement: The author gives a qualitative review order led by the focal palace, followed by opposing and trine contexts, then nhị hợp and adjacent contexts.
limitations: This is not an approved evaluator order or numerical weight.
Nhị hợp and adjacency are not active-profile relation mappings.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New explicit qualitative order; pilot recorded the seven-palace set but not this ordering.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.64-66, examples under xung chiếu and tam chiếu
conditions: A source-described palace relationship is being interpreted semantically rather than merely geometrically.
candidates.neutralStatement: The author distinguishes palace networks considered meaningful from others considered partial, weak or exception-prone, and advises against assuming equal semantic force for every geometric relation.
limitations: The source's individual health, inheritance and family examples are not retained as personal claims.
No geometry is confirmed for the target profile.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New exception-bearing limitation on palace-network semantics.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.66-67, b) Thế giáp
conditions: Adjacent-palace meaning is assessed using the named palace domains and actual context.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source treats adjacency as context-dependent: some named adjacencies are described as direct, while others are one-sided or conditional.
candidates.evidenceType: author-described method with positive and negative examples
limitations: Adjacency has no dedicated active relation entity.
The examples do not authorize personalized family, health or financial conclusions.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Adds explicit exceptions to the pilot's unresolved adjacency vocabulary.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.67, c) Thế nhị hợp
conditions: Nhị hợp is being considered as palace-domain meaning rather than star context.
candidates.neutralStatement: The author discounts direct palace-domain meaning from nhị hợp and instead favors reviewing the stars in the paired palaces.
limitations: The current joined-aspect entity may not be equivalent to the source's nhị hợp term.
This variant is preserved as a conflict, not selected as the active method.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Potential conflict with broader joined-aspect usage; terminology mapping must be reviewed.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.67-68, 2.a-2.b
conditions: A shorter period is reviewed within broader natal and period contexts.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source places Mệnh and Thân context above Đại hạn and Đại hạn above Tiểu hạn, while describing the shorter layer as modifying rather than independently overriding the broader layer.
limitations: No placement algorithm, numerical precedence or event prediction is admitted.
The source's age boundaries are not promoted into the target profile.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Merges with the pilot period-nesting candidate and adds an explicit broader-to-shorter hierarchy.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.69-70, c) Ý nghĩa toàn diện của một số cung
conditions: The section changes palace importance using historical age, sex and health categories.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source proposes context-specific palace priorities for children, women, older adults and ill people.
candidates.evidenceType: historical source claims rejected from reusable knowledge
limitations: The framing contains medical, mortality, gender and dependency assumptions unsuitable for direct modern personalization.
No safe or profile-compatible transformation is established.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Rejected from the Knowledge Base; retained as a reviewed exclusion.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.71-72, A. Quan niệm cần có về các sao
conditions: The author's conceptual model of a star is being described.
candidates.neutralStatement: The author treats star names as conventional labels for human and life factors rather than as literal celestial bodies or deities.
limitations: This is the author's methodological interpretation, not a verified historical fact about origin.
It does not validate any star meaning or personalized claim.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New conceptual framing relative to K12/K13.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.72-73, B.1 Chín loại ý nghĩa
conditions: Star meanings are classified using this author's nine-category taxonomy.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source classifies star descriptions into bodily, appearance, illness, temperament, occupation, wealth, property, fortune/adversity and object-related categories.
limitations: The taxonomy includes sensitive health, sexuality and event examples that are not admitted.
Current ontology does not model these nine categories and should not be expanded without architecture review.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New taxonomy candidate; review before any ontology change.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed p.74, B.2 Ý nghĩa liên đới giữa các sao
conditions: Multiple stars form a source-described combination.
candidates.neutralStatement: The author distinguishes stronger direct interaction under co-location from progressively more indirect aspect contexts, while warning that fine-grained distinctions are not always applied consistently.
limitations: No numeric strength or active evaluator precedence is admitted.
The relation labels require target-profile geometry review.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Adds an explicit caveated relation hierarchy to K13.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.74-76, B.2-B.3
conditions: A star meaning is being interpreted rather than merely cataloged.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source requires star meaning to vary with combination, time context, placement, convergence, yin-yang/five-phase fit and real-world context.
limitations: Historical examples are not retained as personal conclusions.
No factor is assigned a weight, polarity or conflict-resolution algorithm.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Extends the pilot's context-dependence candidate with a bounded factor list.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.77-80, C.1-C.3 and D.1
conditions: The source compares star-count and main-star classifications attributed to Vietnamese and Chinese books.
candidates.neutralStatement: The author reports a Vietnamese catalog of 111 stars with fourteen main stars and contrasts it with Chinese-source variants of 82, 110 or 123 stars and a nineteen-main-star classification.
limitations: The cited books and counts have not been independently collated in this checkpoint.
This does not prove a unified Vietnamese school or the target Nam Phái profile.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New explicit catalog and classification conflict; preserve variants instead of reconciling them.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.80-82, D. Nhận định về độ số các sao
conditions: Star strength classifications from the compared source traditions are being recorded as variants.
candidates.neutralStatement: The section records competing main/auxiliary and rank classifications and explicitly notes unresolved inconsistencies in the compared tables.
candidates.evidenceType: secondary classification tables with author caveats
limitations: No rank is accepted as a weight, score or production ordering.
The embedded tables and cited editions need separate collation before normalization.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Research conflict only; blocked from rule or scoring use.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.52-54, 4.1.1 and Mệnh/Thân comparison cases
conditions: The book's Mệnh/Thân framework is used to review a chart across life stages.
candidates.neutralStatement: The source compares Mệnh and Thân together and assigns them differing age-related emphasis, rather than treating Mệnh as the only review context.
limitations: The current foundation catalog has no stable Thân palace subject, and the source's age boundary is not an approved target-profile rule.
The source examples include health, longevity, sex and personal-outcome claims that are not retained.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Overlaps the pilot's holistic review checklist, but introduces a missing Thân identity and profile-sensitive temporal framing.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.53-75, Mệnh/Thân and selected major-star subsections
conditions: The source gives direct personal outcomes from Mệnh/Thân placements, star states and combinations.
candidates.neutralStatement: The reviewed pages contain direct claims about health, lifespan, sex-specific roles, status, misfortune and life outcomes.
candidates.evidenceType: historical source claims rejected from reusable knowledge
limitations: These claims lack a safe modern interpretation policy and do not establish a calculation or profile mapping.
They must not be transformed into personalized output or scoring.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Recorded as a bounded exclusion for this batch, not as a star-meaning or substantive rule.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.87-88, E. Nhận định về Âm Dương Ngũ Hành các sao, 2.a-2.b
conditions: A source attempts to assess multiple co-located stars through yin-yang and five-phase interactions.
candidates.neutralStatement: The author says general yin-yang/five-phase interaction principles become underdetermined in multi-star cases and do not supply a sufficiently specific rule for every combination.
limitations: This is a limitation record, not permission to infer an outcome or invent a tie-breaker.
No polarity, weight, precedence or active rule is derived.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New explicit source-backed limitation on applying five-phase context to multi-star combinations.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.88-89, F.1 Trường hợp vô chính diện
conditions: The source's void-main-star case is reviewed using a major star in the opposing palace.
candidates.neutralStatement: The author describes an opposition-based approach for a void-main-star palace, distinguishes it from trine review and explicitly notes that no exact relative strength is established.
limitations: The void-main-star term is not a current stable entity and active palace geometry is unresolved.
The source's personal outcome examples are excluded; this cannot activate a calculation or interpretation rule.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Related to the batch-1 caveated relation hierarchy, but adds a source-specific case whose geometry and terminology need specialist review.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.89-91, F.2 Hai sao Tuần, Triệt and b) Phê bình quan điểm Tuần, Triệt của Việt Viêm Tử
conditions: A Tuần/Triệt account proposes effects across co-located stars or aspect-related palaces.
candidates.neutralStatement: The text preserves competing accounts of Tuần/Triệt: an attributed view extends effects to aspect-related contexts, while the author argues that inversion should be limited to co-located stars and rejects a fixed-element account.
candidates.evidenceType: source-internal attributed disagreement and author critique
limitations: Tuần and Triệt are not cataloged stable star entities in the current foundation dataset.
The cited secondary work and target-profile geometry have not been independently collated, and no numerical examples are retained.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: New source-internal conflict record; it preserves variants without choosing an active scope or element mapping.

candidates.sourceLocator: PDF/printed pp.90-92, attributed Tuần/Triệt rules and diagram
conditions: The attributed account assigns numerical harm proportions from sex, yin-yang and palace position.
candidates.neutralStatement: The pages provide profile- and sex-dependent numerical examples for Tuần/Triệt influence, followed by the author's critique.
candidates.evidenceType: attributed numerical claim rejected from reusable knowledge
limitations: No verified calculation profile, reproducible basis or safe interpretation policy is supplied.
The numbers must not become weights, scores, fixtures or personalized claims.
candidates.duplicateAssessment: Rejected; the relevant scholarly value is preserved separately as an unresolved conflict record.

unresolvedIssues.detail: The converter improves many VNI sequences but leaves systematic artifacts such as Tưû, hơïp and ngươøi. Rendered pages remain authoritative.
Different titles and authors do not establish independent textual families; no corroboration claim is made.
Pages 42-51 contain many auxiliary stars and twelve-stage terms absent from the current foundation catalog. They are not added implicitly through candidate statements.
Xung chiếu, tam chiếu, nhị hợp and adjacency language remains source-described and is not mapped to active profile geometry.
